title: Maritime Law I
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the leading international organization in the field of maritime matters."
The International Maritime Organization is the leading international organization in the field of maritime matters.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an area beyond and adjacent to the territorial sea."
Exclusive Economic Zone is an area beyond and adjacent to the territorial sea.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an ancient legal system deriving from customs of the early Egyptians, Phoenicians and Greeks who carried an extensive commerce in the Mediterranean Sea."
Maritime law is an ancient legal system deriving from customs of the early Egyptians, Phoenicians and Greeks who carried an extensive commerce in the Mediterranean Sea.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a contract (between ship owners and the chatterers) for the hire of a ship owned by the ship owners, and the services of its crew for a period of time."
A time charter party is a contract (between ship owners and the chatterers) for the hire of a ship owned by the ship owners, and the services of its crew for a period of time.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the main international convention covering prevention of pollution of the marine environment by ships from operational or accidental causes."
The MARPOL Convention is the main international convention covering prevention of pollution of the marine environment by ships from operational or accidental causes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is regarded as the sovereign territory of the state."
The territorial sea is regarded as the sovereign territory of the state.
fib: ______ is the more modern form of agreement, the origins of the demise charter pre-dating those of time charter parties.
The time Charterparty is the more modern form of agreement, the origins of the demise charter pre-dating those of time charter parties.
______ is a contract, a private contract between two principal parties.
A charter party is a contract, a private contract between two principal parties.

______ is the area of the seabed and subsoil which extends beyond the territorial sea to a distance of 200 nautical miles from the territorial sea baseline and beyond that distance to the continental margins.

The continental shelf is the area of the seabed and subsoil which extends beyond the territorial sea to a distance of 200 nautical miles from the territorial sea baseline and beyond that distance to the continental margins.
______ is a mixture of ancient doctrines and new laws both national and international.
Contemporary maritime law is a mixture of ancient doctrines and new laws both national and international.
______ are those bodies that provide input to and cooperate with the work of statutory organizations.
The non-statutory organizations are those bodies that provide input to and cooperate with the work of statutory organizations.
